This page is used to log in to Douban to read your public marks (wishlist/watched). Credentials are used only for this sync and are not uploaded to any third-party server.

• Why login: to read your Douban marks (wishlist, watched, ratings)
• What is stored: only Cookie and userId (for this crawl), NOT your Douban password
• Cookie usage: only for requesting movie.douban.com/people/{userId}/wish|collect pages
• After sync: you can clear Douban credentials anytime in Settings
• Data flow: Douban → App → Trakt, no intermediate servers

pansou_template: compatible with PanSou API response format. This format places the resource list under the data field, with each resource containing title, url, type, etc.
zreso_template: compatible with ZReso API response format. This format places the resource list under the data.list field, with possibly different field names.
custom: custom mode, requires JSONPath expressions (e.g. $.data.results) to parse JSON response yourself.

If API returns JSON: {"data": {"results": [{"title": "Movie Name", "url": "https://...", "type": "quark"}]}}

Q: What do the numbers above mean?\nA: They show your total watched count (movies + shows), this month\'s watched count, and this year\'s watched count, based on your Trakt history.
Q: What is the watching heatmap?\nA: Similar to GitHub\'s contribution graph, each square represents one day. The darker the color, the more you watched that day. It covers the past year.
Q: What is the genre distribution pie chart?\nA: It shows the proportion of each genre in your watched history. Tap a slice to see the exact count and percentage.
Q: What is the top genres ranking?\nA: Your most-watched genres ranked by count. The top three are marked with gold, silver, and bronze medals.
Q: How is watch time calculated?\nA: It sums up the runtime of every movie and episode you watched, displayed in hours.
Q: What are rating statistics?\nA: Shows your total number of ratings, average rating, and rating distribution on Trakt. Only rated titles are counted.
